name: Open-flower witchgrass
desc: Soft-tuft panic grass (Dichanthelium laxiflorum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Dichanthelium laxiflorum, commonly known as open-flower witchgrass, is a perennial graminoid in the family Poaceae that is found throughout the Americas.
